messages:
maya: quick heads up — planning to swap kernel -> v3.4.0 in the late-afternoon change window today (AWS us-west-2). aiming for 16:30 PT.

samir: noted. are we doing a gradual traffic shift or straight swap?

maya: gradual. deploy-bot has a staged-slice option. plan: 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% by 10m buckets with smoke gates.

olga: the quant builds for v3.4.0 were produced last night — sha: d4f7a9c. I pinned the quant artifact on staging. production artifact is ready but not pinned yet.

jordan: can we confirm rollback criteria up-front? last time a subtle kv-cache miss caused 0.3% error spike.

maya: yes. rollback if: 1) 5xx rate > 0.25% above baseline for 5m, or 2) 99th latency increases > 30% for 10m, or 3) model outputs show >2% regression on smoke prompts (we'll run the eval set).

tom: what about binary signature mismatch earlier? do we need a preflight signature check on nodes before shift?

olga: good call — I'm adding an extra preflight that verifies kernel hash + quant sha on each node. command we use:

```
# verify files on node
sha256sum /opt/redwood/runtime/kernel_v3.4.0 || exit 1
sha256sum /opt/redwood/runtime/quant_d4f7a9c || exit 1
```

maya: deploy-bot, please schedule the swap with the staged-slice and attach the smoke eval job. tag owners: @samir @olga @jordan for watch.

deploy-bot: Scheduling kernel swap: v3.3.7 -> v3.4.0. Change window: 2024-11-05 16:30 PT. Staged slices: [1,10,50,100]. Smoke eval will run after each stage. On-call: samir. React with :white_check_mark: to acknowledge.

samir: :white_check_mark: I will be on call and watching metrics.

jordan: I'll run the smoke eval harness and post results in this thread.

olga: I'll watch the quant telemetry and preflight hashes.

tom: please add a fail-open policy: if a node fails preflight it should be excluded, not cause whole stage to fail unless exclusion rate > 5%.

maya: agreed. deploy-bot set exclusion-threshold=5%.

deploy-bot: updated change: exclusion_threshold=5%. Canary window timeout=10m. Automatic rollback enabled. Fallback route: model-compat v3.3.7.

sre-bot: alerting: I created temporary golden-alerts for this swap — channels: #eng-runtime, #incidents, pager to SRE on-call. Thresholds match rollback criteria.

jordan: smoke eval first stage results: 1% slice -> all checks pass, output diffs <0.2%, 99p latency no change. Posting raw summary to /tmp/smoke-1746200000.log

olga: preflight hashes verified on 98% of nodes, 2 nodes excluded (old image). exclusion rate 2% < 5% threshold. proceeding to 10%.

maya: proceeding. I'm going to update release notes draft: include kernel changelog (matmul kernel fixes, kv-cache eviction edgecase), quant note (aligned kernel ops), and rollback steps.

samir: during 10% slice I'm seeing a small increase in transient tokenization CPU on model-hotpath +5% — watching if it stabilizes.

jordan: 10% stage smoke: eval diffs still <0.5%. latency uptick normalized after autoscale. hold for 10m then 50%.

tom: reminder: ops-runbook snippet for rollback is:

```
# rollback to previous kernel pin
deploy-bot rollback --target kernel:v3.3.7 --reason "post-swap regression"
# verify
deploy-bot status --since 15m
kubectl get pods -l app=runtime -o wide
```

maya: if we hit rollback criteria, I want immediate pin + safe-drain on affected AZs.

deploy-bot: 50% stage started. Smoke eval queued.

sre-bot: alert: 99p latency exceeded threshold in us-west-2 for 3m. Current delta +35%.

samir: seeing same, starting diagnostic traces. rolling back the 50% stage now.

deploy-bot: Initiating rollback to kernel v3.3.7 as requested by samir — staged slices reverting. Estimated completion 6m.

jordan: smoke eval after rollback shows diffs back to baseline. 99p latency back under threshold.

maya: good call. let's hold the change. set follow-up: investigate tokenization CPU bump root cause, re-run quant perf microbench with 2048 input lengths.

olga: capturing artifacts and logs: /artifacts/kernel_swap/1746200000/*. Tarball will be uploaded.

samir: postmortem planned tomorrow 10:00 PT. I'll create the doc and invite relevant owners.

maya: thanks all. closing the thread for now. We'll reschedule once we have root cause and a safer build. :v:
